name: get_weather
description: Get weather information. No additional parameters.

name: get_time
description: Get the current system time with day-level granularity. No additional parameters. Returns format: yyyy-mm-dd

name: task_done
description: Task complete. No additional parameters. Calling this signals that the task has ended.

name: chat_response
description: Relay a message to the user. Requires one parameter: text

text.description: Text content to reply to the user

name: task_summary
description: Task summary tool. This tool is used to produce a logical summary of the entire execution process of the current task. As an essential step in task closure, you should use this tool before calling task_done (task end) to consolidate scattered task steps, acquired data, and final processing results into a clear report and relay it to the user. The summary should include: 1. Key steps executed; 2. Core data or information obtained; 3. Final recommendations or a preview of the processing results for the user. Calling this tool is prohibited before the task has started or before substantial progress has been made.

key_findings.description: A list of key findings or completed steps

final_conclusion.description: The final concluding statement, to be relayed directly to the user

name: path_workspace
description: View the current workspace path. Use this tool to obtain the path of the current workspace.

name: list_remote_sensing_index
description: Query available indices. Use this tool to view all satellite remote sensing indices that the remote sensing band index calculation tool can compute. The tool lists all computable indices and the corresponding index parameters required. Supported index types include: Vegetation indices (ndvi, savi, evi, gndvi, arvi, msavi, lai, sr, osavi, rdvi, cvi, cigreen, grvi, gli, vari), Water indices (ndwi, mndwi, awei_nsh, awei_sh, ndti), Soil indices (gsi, ci, bi, bi2, ri, sci, ndshi, ndsvi), Algae indices (fai, ndci, sabi, atbi, cig), Burn/Pigment/Building indices (bai, nbr, sipi, vgnir_bi, building_bi).

name: remote_sensing_calculate_cli
description: Remote sensing band index calculation tool. A professional remote sensing band index calculation tool for processing satellite or aerial remote sensing images, computing various specialized indices to extract land surface information. Supports multiple index calculations, batch processing, and parallel acceleration. Suitable for remote sensing data analysis, environmental monitoring, land use classification, and similar scenarios. This tool runs under /var/opt/my_app_2.

input_path.description: Path to a single TIF file, or a directory containing multiple TIF files

output_path.description: Output TIF file path or output directory path

workers.description: Optional. Number of parallel worker threads

name: bash_ls
description: Bash command-line tool ls. Functionally equivalent to the Linux ls command. Lists the file structure of the current or specified directory. This tool runs under /var/opt.

target_path.description: Target directory for ls. Defaults to the current directory if omitted

show_hidden.description: Whether to show hidden files. Default: false

show_detail.description: Whether to show detailed file information. Default: false

pattern.description: Regular expression to filter ls results

name: gf_pms_preprocess_cli
description: Gaofen satellite image preprocessing system. A scenario-level batch preprocessing pipeline system designed specifically for Gaofen satellite images. Supports end-to-end processing of GF1/GF1B/GF1C/GF1D/GF6 satellite data. Preprocessing pipeline: Input raw image -> step1 RPC coarse orthorectification -> step2 Radiometric calibration -> step3 6S atmospheric correction -> step4 Fusion (brovey/nndiffuse) -> step5 Fine registration (SIFT or SuperPoint+LightGlue ONNX tiled registration). Note: the fusion step (step4) and fine registration step (step5) have high performance requirements and significant memory overhead — use with caution. This tool runs under /var/opt/my_app_1.

input_path.description: Input image data path. Supports files or directories

case.description: Template parameter. Runs the tool with a fixed template at specified steps. 1: step1+step2 coarse orthorectification only; 2: step1~step3 through atmospheric correction; 3: step1~step4 through fusion; 4: step1~step5 through fine registration (full pipeline)

mem.description: Memory strategy. Default: balanced. balanced: balanced strategy; low: low memory strategy (slower but more memory-efficient); ultra_low: ultra-low memory strategy (slowest but most memory-efficient); high: high performance strategy (fast but higher memory consumption)

name: get_tools_list
description: Get the current list of available tools. Returns a list of all currently available tools.

name: dcva_cd
description: Remote sensing change detection tool. A remote sensing change detection tool for comparing two remote sensing images of the same area from different times and outputting the changed areas / change mask. When the user mentions requirements such as 'change detection', 'bi-temporal image comparison', 'two remote sensing image comparison', 'old vs new image difference', 'change area extraction', or 'change mask', prioritize this tool. Supports two modes: single image pair change detection and A/B folder batch change detection. This tool runs under /var/opt/my_app_4.

input_path.description: Input path. Supports two forms: 1) Single image pair: pass the first temporal image path, must also pass img2; 2) A/B folder batch: pass the folder path containing A/ and B/ subdirectories

img2.description: Second temporal image path. Required in single image pair mode

output_path.description: Output change detection result image path or output directory

name: file_search
description: File search tool. Searches for all files whose names contain the given keyword in their paths. Returns a list of absolute paths of matching files.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the search is case-sensitive. Default: false

name: wait_user_instruction
description: Wait for user input. This tool outputs a prompt message to the user and then waits for the user's instruction input. Use this tool when you find the user's instructions ambiguous, need additional user input, or in any situation requiring interaction with the user.

tip.description: A prompt message for the user, indicating what kind of instruction they should provide

name: dir_search
description: Directory search tool. Searches for all directories whose absolute paths contain the given keyword. Returns a list of absolute paths of matching directories.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the search is case-sensitive. Default: false

name: plan
description: This tool is used to decompose and plan complex tasks you are about to execute into multiple clear, actionable steps that can then be executed step by step. Use this tool when you need to plan task execution steps or are in plan mode, before initiating other tool calls. The final step of the plan **must** use task_done to end the task, and before ending you **must** use task_summary at least once to summarize the task.

title.description: Task title, describing the subject of the planned task

steps.description: List of planned task execution steps

expected_tools.description: List of expected tool names to use

name: search_tif_data
description: Satellite image data retrieval tool. Searches for matching TIF files under the /data directory based on time and region information. Returns a list of absolute paths of matching files. This is a domain-specific search tool for locating satellite image data.

year.description: Data time — year, format yyyy, e.g. 2024

month.description: Data time — month, format mm (e.g. 01). When omitted, matches all months of the year

day.description: Data time — day, format dd (e.g. 15). When omitted, matches all days of the month. Only meaningful when month is not omitted

region.description: Region name corresponding to the data (e.g. Shanghai, Beijing, etc.)

latest_descending.description: Whether to sort in descending order by time. Default: True
